content.text:
The contact page was overflowing sideways on phones, and it no longer does. On a 390px-wide viewport it was 424px wide, which pushed the form fields and card past the screen edge. I couldn't confirm that's what the customer saw, and the repo has only one commit, so I couldn't check what changed in yesterday's update.

The cause was the long email address in the "Other ways to reach us" card. In the single-column mobile layout, that unbreakable text widened the column past the screen.

The fix is in `site/css/pages.css`:
- The mobile `.contact-grid` column is now `minmax(0, 1fr)`, so content can't stretch it.
- `.info-list dd` now has `overflow-wrap: anywhere`, so long values wrap instead of overflowing.

I re-rendered the page after the change. At 390px it now fits (390 wide), and the desktop layout is unchanged. The 16 functional tests pass.

The `.idea` and `.vscode` folders showing as untracked were already there, not from me. I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
